description: This file defines an interface 'CommandInterface' in the Aws namespace, which specifies methods for AWS command objects to implement. It includes methods for converting commands to arrays, retrieving command names, checking parameters, and obtaining handler lists.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the command parameters to an associative array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the command.

methods.name: hasParam
methods.description: Checks if the command has a parameter with the specified name.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list used to transfer the command.
